title: Blitch's brief SAIC tenure, never read in

tellings.quote: stuff so um so yeah uh I was never R into anything at SS

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, who says he was abducted by an alien, says that in 2001 he worked briefly at SAIC, a large defense contractor, in Littleton, Colorado. He says he was never "read in", meaning never cleared into any secret program there, and he names a man called Art Morris in the account.
